note: Planning values for commercial buildings in North America (offices, retail, restaurants, schools, assembly, industrial). Layer rows are material resistances from published tables (Energy Code Ace, ASHRAE, IECC samples, manufacturer sheets). Assembly rows are whole-element coefficients. Climate-zone rows are IECC prescriptive limits for zone 5 and marine 4, all other — not a test of a specific building. potentialSupplier names common NA producers for that material class; confirm the project supplier. SHGC is omitted where the cited source did not state it.
